title: Observed new-session context comparison
method: Paired fresh Codex sessions on the same isolated worktree. The LAC session used installed architecture-context instructions and source-backed context; the comparison session used normal targeted repository discovery.
limitations: One observed real workflow, not a universal token, latency, cost, or correctness benchmark.
The private repository, source, configuration, prompts, and raw logs are intentionally excluded from this public repository.
This artifact makes the published arithmetic and SVG reproducible from the observed aggregate values; it cannot reproduce the private workflow.
